avalanche data build.inputs: Capture directory --from, registered dataset ID, new --output.
avalanche data build.effects: Creates normalized Parquet and build receipts. --preview resolves local inputs/writes without creating output; no capture retrieval.
avalanche data build.credentials: None for local normalization of an existing capture.

avalanche data check.inputs: Capture directory, optional built dataset and optional repeatable built reference directories.
avalanche data check.effects: When --dataset is supplied writes or replaces its check.json, even though command is named check. Without --dataset reports capture-only validation. Multiple --against allowed for metrics or builderhub primary dataset; otherwise at most one. Non-pass status exits 1.
avalanche data check.credentials: None for checks over delivered local captures and references.

avalanche data derive.inputs: Derived dataset ID and existing built upstream runs. --input DATASET_ID=RUN overrides otherwise-newest selection.
avalanche data derive.effects: Creates derived capture/build/Parquet receipts in a new output run. No --preview option. Rejects modules without derive. Newest selection is not a frozen research input unless pinned explicitly.
avalanche data derive.credentials: No generic provider credentials for local derived builds; fetch needed upstream runs separately.

avalanche data describe.effects: Read-only; unknown ID is an error.

avalanche data fetch.inputs: Registered dataset ID, new output path, source-specific repeated KEY=VALUE params; some captures require built upstream runs.
avalanche data fetch.effects: Without --preview makes network/provider requests and creates immutable capture files/receipts in a new directory. May consume API limits or billable query resources. --preview resolves requests/writes without network; may read local catalog/upstream run metadata.
avalanche data fetch.credentials: Source-dependent: Snowflake named connection avalanche (AVALANCHE_SNOWFLAKE_CONNECTION overrides name). Optional AVALANCHE_DATA_API_KEY for glacier-api host. SEC captures require AVALANCHE_SEC_CONTACT identity. Other supported endpoints commonly public; inspect selected module/source contract.

avalanche data freshness.inputs: Live configured sources plus existing local walk runs.
avalanche data freshness.effects: Live Snowflake queries, P-Chain/Tenderly/Data API/metrics requests and local Parquet reads. Can use provider quota/query resources. No output-file option; unreadable or >36-hour-old sources become findings. Not an offline status command.
avalanche data freshness.credentials: Snowflake named connection and access to referenced share tables; optional Data API key.

avalanche data list.effects: Read-only; prints declared implemented sources/datasets. Not a provider connectivity test.

avalanche data manifest.effects: Read-only; reports declarations, not existing run inventory.

avalanche data pin.inputs: One or more dataset IDs with built runs whose recorded check status passes; optional explicit DATASET=RUN; local Git object/ref for code binding.
avalanche data pin.effects: Creates data/pins/NAME.json, hashes Parquets and records capture identities. Refuses an existing pin. Defaults to newest run per dataset. --code-ref requires --code-commit and must point to that commit.

avalanche data pin-check.inputs: Existing pin, its local built Parquets/receipts/check records, and any bound Git objects/refs.
avalanche data pin-check.effects: Read-only; hashes inputs and checks stored check.json status. Does not rerun each dataset checker and does not download missing snapshots. Changed/missing inputs or code bindings produce attention and exit 1.

avalanche data runs.inputs: Existing data/runs receipts; dataset ID is optional.
avalanche data runs.effects: Read-only; scans run metadata, does not fetch missing datasets.

avalanche model check.inputs: Built primary-validator-stakes, primary-delegator-stakes and primary-staking-supply dataset directories.
avalanche model check.effects: Reads local Parquets, recomputes potential protocol rewards by regime and reports mismatches. No check.json write in this CLI callback. May scan many rows; does not validate behavioral forecasts.
avalanche model check.credentials: None for local captured reward reconstruction.

avalanche model describe.effects: Read-only; describes protocol parameters/mechanisms, not fitted responses or a full model specification.

avalanche model reward.inputs: AVAX stake, days duration, UTC start and AVAX supply. Parser accepts nonnegative numbers; protocol applies further validity rules.
avalanche model reward.effects: Data-free deterministic potential reward calculation. Converts AVAX to integer nAVAX and days to integer seconds using round. Does not predict validator behavior, check uptime or pay/submit a reward.

avalanche model run.inputs: Existing pin and pinned input datasets; valid pre-lockbox --origin; registered model variant; output directory.
avalanche model run.effects: Fits/prepares and simulates one scenario as a one-row sweep, writes Parquet output plus sweep receipt, may use worker processes and substantial CPU/RAM. Defaults v0.8.0, 20 runs, 180 days, seed 0, auto workers. No dry-run/preview flag.
avalanche model run.credentials: None for offline simulation after inputs are available. Pin never retrieves snapshots.

avalanche model sweep.inputs: Existing JSON design, its pin and pinned local datasets, optional hash-bound rows/draws files and KPI design; optional --pin override.
avalanche model sweep.effects: Executes design rows across selected registered variants/origins/settings, with row Parquets and receipt; may fit, simulate and reduce KPIs. Existing valid rows can be skipped/resumed by runner contract. Controls for runs/days/seeds/workers live in design, not CLI flags. No dry-run/preview flag.
avalanche model sweep.credentials: None for offline simulation after inputs are available.

avalanche research tree.inputs: Git checkout with project markers. Optional root/view/depth.
avalanche research tree.effects: Read-only; Git-index path inventory and current working-tree frontmatter. Default excludes untracked/missing/symlink/runtime/private-cache paths; optional nonignored untracked inventory excludes data. Default wiki depth 4 and repo depth 2; explicit --depth exposes nested files. No data contents or network. Tree schema differs from standard CLI result envelope.
